A grassroots initiative encouraging Muslim children to attend congregational Fajr prayers in Algeria has grown into an international movement, inspiring thousands of youngsters to fill mosques before sunrise. What began with just six children in Algeria’s Sétif province has inspired similar efforts across the Arab world and Türkiye. The ‘Men of Fajr’ movement seeks to nurture a generation of Muslims firmly rooted in their faith, cultivating a love for salah and establishing a lifelong attachment to the mosque from an early age. #ageria #syria #muslimworld #salah #fajr
